name: 香槟金小黄瓶精华液款
description: 香槟金瓶身面部精华套图：金萃质感、暗沉痛点对比与规格信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, blush cream #F6EFE4 for benefit and infographic panels, warm stone and deep bronze accent surfaces for scene and macro shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, restrained champagne glow accents
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm-stone counter and soft champagne satin accents
styleLock.iconSystem: minimal thin-line icons in champagne gold only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and consistent product scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium champagne-gold skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, blush cream #F6EFE4, champagne-gold accent #C89B5E and deep warm brown text #4A3B2E; bright soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line icons in champagne gold only; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with lightweight infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle standing upright and centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, the bottle standing upright and centered, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front key and gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottle. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no floating product, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达金萃质感的核心卖点，承接首图
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, bottle on the left overlapping a large droplet circle behind it
shots.lighting: soft warm studio key from the front left, gentle glow on the droplet, soft contact shadow
shots.background: blush cream #F6EFE4 with a champagne-gold #E8C87E serum-droplet circle
shots.props: one large abstract serum-droplet circle and a few soft sphere accents, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper third reserved for the headline zone
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 hero angle with the bottle on the left, overlapping a large champagne-gold #E8C87E serum-droplet circle behind it. Soft warm studio key from the front left, a gentle glow on the droplet, soft contact shadow. Blush cream background #F6EFE4. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space in the upper third reserved for the headline zone. Negative: no efficacy claims or percentages, no invented patent numbers, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no duplicated spheres.

shots.intent: 放大肤色暗沉无光的日常困扰，引出产品作为解决项
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, straight-on panels, identical crop and lighting on both sides
shots.lighting: left panel flat and heavy, right panel soft warm key, consistent top light
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, only a thin divider between the two panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical straight-on framing and lighting. Left panel: an abstract patch of dull, tired-looking skin texture under flat heavy light, conveying a lackluster complexion without showing a real face. Right panel: {product} standing in soft warm light as the resolving force. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Warm grey-blush background #E9DED6 on both panels, soft top light, heavier shading on the left panel. The product occupies 40-50% of its panel, with no extra whitespace between the panels except a thin divider. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated before-and-after skin results, no efficacy claims or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入清晨梳妆的真实使用场景，强化自用代入感
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel, bottle upright on the vanity top
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left around 5500K, gentle shadows falling right
shots.background: warm oak vanity top #D9C7B0 with a soft-lit mirror edge behind
shots.props: a folded towel and a small ceramic tray, never covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} on a warm oak vanity top #D9C7B0 beside a soft-lit mirror edge, a calm morning getting-ready moment. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel, the bottle standing upright among minimal objects. Soft morning window light from the left around 5500K, gentle shadows falling right. Props: a folded towel and a small ceramic tray, never covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no cluttered countertop, no garbled text on objects, no watermark, no fake logo, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 用微距质地证明精萃品感，留出气泡位承载卖点
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the serum texture, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing fine texture, warm controlled highlight
shots.props: two small empty speech-bubble frames beside the product
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture detail is the subject, only small margins around the bubbles
shots.textZone: two small bubble zones left and right of the product
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on a suspended drop of amber serum and its silky flowing texture. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Macro lens at shallow depth of field with the foreground droplet sharp. Skimming side light from the right revealing fine texture with a warm controlled highlight. Deep bronze background #4E3B2B. The texture detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal margin, no extra whitespace. Two small empty speech-bubble frames reserved beside the product for 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented ingredient percentages, no efficacy claims, no extra text outside the reserved bubbles, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用结构化参数版位消除规格疑虑，参数行留空后期填入
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, bottle upright on the right
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadows
shots.background: blush cream #F6EFE4 with a clean white #FFFFFF info card on the left
shots.props: one rounded white info card with empty ruled rows and blank parameter lines
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the info card balances the layout
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec infographic for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the bottle upright on the right. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadows. Blush cream background #F6EFE4 with a clean white #FFFFFF info card on the left holding empty ruled rows and blank parameter lines as proof placeholders, all left blank for post-editing. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no invented brand names, no fabricated specifications, volumes, concentrations or ingredient percentages, no readable dense text, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code.

shots.intent: 用留白徽标位降解除购风险，不伪造任何资质
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level product angle, bottle on the right with empty badge slots on the left
shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one large empty seal frame and two empty capsule-shaped badge slots, all blank
shots.whitespace: generous whitespace around the empty badge slots on the left
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level product angle with the bottle on the right, and one large empty seal frame plus two empty capsule-shaped badge slots on the left, all left blank for post-editing. Even clean studio light with a soft contact shadow. Pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous whitespace around the empty badge slots. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, test data or volunteer studies; no filled badges, no fake logos, no extra text, no watermark, no QR code.

shots.intent: 双瓶组合收口促单，留出按钮位承接行动文案
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle looking upward at the duo, heroic presence
shots.lighting: warm punchy studio light with a champagne-gold glow panel behind the bottles, soft contact shadows
shots.background: champagne-gold #E5C88F glow panel over blush cream #F6EFE4
shots.props: one empty rounded CTA button placeholder in the lower fifth
shots.whitespace: the lower fifth stays clean as a CTA button zone
shots.promptTemplate: Promotional closing shot of {product} with a second unit beside it forming a duo set. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward at the duo for a heroic presence. Warm punchy studio light with a champagne-gold #E5C88F glow panel behind the bottles over a blush cream #F6EFE4 base, soft contact shadows. The duo occupies 55-60% of the frame, and the lower fifth stays clean as a CTA button zone holding one empty rounded button placeholder. Negative: no real discount numbers or countdowns, no invented claims, no member badges, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1 双支香槟金瓶卖点主图，金色分子球道具与放射光背景；屏2 单瓶配金色滴露圆形底图；屏3 三枚圆形利益点标签与玫瑰金分子卡片；屏4 两张成分卡片（页内专利号与成分浓度数字均已剥离，不搬运）；屏5 单瓶立体卖点图带两个气泡框（页脚描述的滴管取用与瓶身造型不一致，滴管与泵头两种说法均未写入，瓶型交由 {product} 占位）；屏6 第三方测评对比版位（本套图不搬运测评数据，对比位处理为空白 proof 占位思路，见屏6参数行留空与屏7空徽标位）；屏7 产品信息参数表与问答（品牌行、规格行、成分行、功效行均改为空参数行留空）；屏8 二维码与会员角标（剥离）。品类判定：屏7参数区品名为精华小黄瓶、问答内容围绕面部皮肤使用与耳后测试，使用部位为面部，判定为面部精华，属护肤个护/面部护理，而非洗护发；源夹名仅为线索不作依据。已剥离：品牌字样与系列名、原文案原句、专利与检测与志愿者数据、成分浓度百分比、功效断言、会员与促销角标、二维码、水印；产品一律以 {product} 占位，参数行与徽标留空为空白 proof 占位。
